title: REQ · Admin token middleware and round/admin configuration
summary: Reject missing or wrong admin credentials and add config for token and round defaults
description: Context: no admin protection exists. Desired behavior: middleware requiring Authorization: Bearer <admin token> with constant-time comparison, failing closed when no token is configured; config gains admin.token (env STORYFORGE_ADMIN_TOKEN) and round.duration, base_release, scheduler_interval defaults. Expected result: admin routes are unreachable without the token.
acceptance_criteria: Given no Authorization header, when called, then 401 and next handler not run
Given a wrong token, when called, then 401
Given an empty configured token, when any request arrives, then 401
Given round config absent, when loaded, then duration is 24h, base_release 1.0.0, scheduler_interval 30s

preserve: existing config defaults and env overrides
